name: io.github.bmscomp/kates
title: Kates MCP Server
description: Read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Apache Kafka cluster diagnostics, benchmark run analysis, chaos dry-run previews, and security posture audits.

packageArguments.description: Start the read-only Kates MCP server over stdio

packageArguments.name: --context
packageArguments.description: Explicit Kates CLI context name (for example, ports or lab)

packageArguments.name: --allow-cluster
packageArguments.description: Kafka clusterId that this MCP server is permitted to inspect

environmentVariables.name: KATES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key override for the Kates API (defaults to the key stored in the named CLI context)
